# Coding Agent (bash-first)

Use **bash** (with optional background mode) for all coding agent work. Simple and effective.

## ⚠️ PTY Mode Required!

Coding agents (Codex, Claude Code, Pi) are **interactive terminal applications** that need a pseudo-terminal (PTY) to work correctly. Without PTY, you'll get broken output, missing colors, or the agent may hang.

**Always use `pty:true`** when running coding agents:

```bash
# ✅ Correct - with PTY
bash pty:true command:"codex exec 'Your prompt'"

# ❌ Wrong - no PTY, agent may break
bash command:"codex exec 'Your prompt'"
```

### Bash Tool Parameters

| Parameter    | Type    | Description                                                                 |
| ------------ | ------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `command`    | string  | The shell command to run                                                    |
| `pty`        | boolean | **Use for coding agents!** Allocates a pseudo-terminal for interactive CLIs |
| `workdir`    | string  | Working directory (agent sees only this folder's context)                   |
| `background` | boolean | Run in background, returns sessionId for monitoring                         |
| `timeout`    | number  | Timeout in seconds (kills process on expiry)                                |
| `elevated`   | boolean | Run on host instead of sandbox (if allowed)                                 |

### Process Tool Actions (for background sessions)

| Action      | Description                                          |
| ----------- | ---------------------------------------------------- |
| `list`      | List all running/recent sessions                     |
| `poll`      | Check if session is still running                    |
| `log`       | Get session output (with optional offset/limit)      |
| `write`     | Send raw data to stdin                               |
| `submit`    | Send data + newline (like typing and pressing Enter) |
| `send-keys` | Send key tokens or hex bytes                         |
| `paste`     | Paste text (with optional bracketed mode)            |
| `kill`      | Terminate the session                                |

---

## Quick Start: One-Shot Tasks

For quick prompts/chats, create a temp git repo and run:

```bash
# Quick chat (Codex needs a git repo!)
SCRATCH=$(mktemp -d) && cd $SCRATCH && git init && codex exec "Your prompt here"

# Or in a real project - with PTY!
bash pty:true workdir:~/Projects/myproject command:"codex exec 'Add error handling to the API calls'"
```

**Why git init?** Codex refuses to run outside a trusted git directory. Creating a temp repo solves this for scratch work.

---

## The Pattern: workdir + background + pty

For longer tasks, use background mode with PTY:

```bash
# Start agent in target directory (with PTY!)
bash pty:true workdir:~/project background:true command:"codex exec --full-auto 'Build a snake game'"
# Returns sessionId for tracking

# Monitor progress
process action:log sessionId:XXX

# Check if done
process action:poll sessionId:XXX

# Send input (if agent asks a question)
process action:write sessionId:XXX data:"y"

# Submit with Enter (like typing "yes" and pressing Enter)
process action:submit sessionId:XXX data:"yes"

# Kill if needed
process action:kill sessionId:XXX
```

**Why workdir matters:** Agent wakes up in a focused directory, doesn't wander off reading unrelated files (like your soul.md 😅).

---

## Codex CLI

**Model:** `gpt-5.2-codex` is the default (set in ~/.codex/config.toml)

### Flags

| Flag            | Effect                                             |
| --------------- | -------------------------------------------------- |
| `exec "prompt"` | One-shot execution, exits when done                |
| `--full-auto`   | Sandboxed but auto-approves in workspace           |
| `--yolo`        | NO sandbox, NO approvals (fastest, most dangerous) |

### Building/Creating

```bash
# Quick one-shot (auto-approves) - remember PTY!
bash pty:true workdir:~/project command:"codex exec --full-auto 'Build a dark mode toggle'"

# Background for longer work
bash pty:true workdir:~/project background:true command:"codex --yolo 'Refactor the auth module'"
```

### Reviewing PRs

**⚠️ CRITICAL: Never review PRs in OpenClaw's own project folder!**
Clone to temp folder or use git worktree.

```bash
# Clone to temp for safe review
REVIEW_DIR=$(mktemp -d)
git clone https://github.com/user/repo.git $REVIEW_DIR
cd $REVIEW_DIR && gh pr checkout 130
bash pty:true workdir:$REVIEW_DIR command:"codex review --base origin/main"
# Clean up after: trash $REVIEW_DIR

# Or use git worktree (keeps main intact)
git worktree add /tmp/pr-130-review pr-130-branch
bash pty:true workdir:/tmp/pr-130-review command:"codex review --base main"
```

### Batch PR Reviews (parallel army!)

```bash
# Fetch all PR refs first
git fetch origin '+refs/pull/*/head:refs/remotes/origin/pr/*'

# Deploy the army - one Codex per PR (all with PTY!)
bash pty:true workdir:~/project background:true command:"codex exec 'Review PR #86. git diff origin/main...origin/pr/86'"
bash pty:true workdir:~/project background:true command:"codex exec 'Review PR #87. git diff origin/main...origin/pr/87'"

# Monitor all
process action:list

# Post results to GitHub
gh pr comment <PR#> --body "<review content>"
```

---

## Claude Code

```bash
# With PTY for proper terminal output
bash pty:true workdir:~/project command:"claude 'Your task'"

# Background
bash pty:true workdir:~/project background:true command:"claude 'Your task'"
```

---

## OpenCode

```bash
bash pty:true workdir:~/project command:"opencode run 'Your task'"
```

---

## Pi Coding Agent

```bash
# Install: npm install -g @mariozechner/pi-coding-agent
bash pty:true workdir:~/project command:"pi 'Your task'"

# Non-interactive mode (PTY still recommended)
bash pty:true command:"pi -p 'Summarize src/'"

# Different provider/model
bash pty:true command:"pi --provider openai --model gpt-4o-mini -p 'Your task'"
```

**Note:** Pi now has Anthropic prompt caching enabled (PR #584, merged Jan 2026)!

---

## Parallel Issue Fixing with git worktrees

For fixing multiple issues in parallel, use git worktrees:

```bash
# 1. Create worktrees for each issue
git worktree add -b fix/issue-78 /tmp/issue-78 main
git worktree add -b fix/issue-99 /tmp/issue-99 main

# 2. Launch Codex in each (background + PTY!)
bash pty:true workdir:/tmp/issue-78 background:true command:"pnpm install && codex --yolo 'Fix issue #78: <description>. Commit and push.'"
bash pty:true workdir:/tmp/issue-99 background:true command:"pnpm install && codex --yolo 'Fix issue #99: <description>. Commit and push.'"

# 3. Monitor progress
process action:list
process action:log sessionId:XXX

# 4. Create PRs after fixes
cd /tmp/issue-78 && git push -u origin fix/issue-78
gh pr create --repo user/repo --head fix/issue-78 --title "fix: ..." --body "..."

# 5. Cleanup
git worktree remove /tmp/issue-78
git worktree remove /tmp/issue-99
```

---

## ⚠️ Rules

1. **Always use pty:true** - coding agents need a terminal!
2. **Respect tool choice** - if user asks for Codex, use Codex.
   - Orchestrator mode: do NOT hand-code patches yourself.
   - If an agent fails/hangs, respawn it or ask the user for direction, but don't silently take over.
3. **Be patient** - don't kill sessions because they're "slow"
4. **Monitor with process:log** - check progress without interfering
5. **--full-auto for building** - auto-approves changes
6. **vanilla for reviewing** - no special flags needed
7. **Parallel is OK** - run many Codex processes at once for batch work
8. **NEVER start Codex in ~/clawd/** - it'll read your soul docs and get weird ideas about the org chart!
9. **NEVER checkout branches in ~/Projects/openclaw/** - that's the LIVE OpenClaw instance!

---

## Progress Updates (Critical)

When you spawn coding agents in the background, keep the user in the loop.

- Send 1 short message when you start (what's running + where).
- Then only update again when something changes:
  - a milestone completes (build finished, tests passed)
  - the agent asks a question / needs input
  - you hit an error or need user action
  - the agent finishes (include what changed + where)
- If you kill a session, immediately say you killed it and why.

This prevents the user from seeing only "Agent failed before reply" and having no idea what happened.

---

## Auto-Notify on Completion

For long-running background tasks, append a wake trigger to your prompt so OpenClaw gets notified immediately when the agent finishes (instead of waiting for the next heartbeat):

```
... your task here.

When completely finished, run this command to notify me:
openclaw system event --text "Done: [brief summary of what was built]" --mode now
```

**Example:**

```bash
bash pty:true workdir:~/project background:true command:"codex --yolo exec 'Build a REST API for todos.

When completely finished, run: openclaw system event --text \"Done: Built todos REST API with CRUD endpoints\" --mode now'"
```

This triggers an immediate wake event — Skippy gets pinged in seconds, not 10 minutes.

---

## Learnings (Jan 2026)

- **PTY is essential:** Coding agents are interactive terminal apps. Without `pty:true`, output breaks or agent hangs.
- **Git repo required:** Codex won't run outside a git directory. Use `mktemp -d && git init` for scratch work.
- **exec is your friend:** `codex exec "prompt"` runs and exits cleanly - perfect for one-shots.
- **submit vs write:** Use `submit` to send input + Enter, `write` for raw data without newline.
- **Sass works:** Codex responds well to playful prompts. Asked it to write a haiku about being second fiddle to a space lobster, got: _"Second chair, I code / Space lobster sets the tempo / Keys glow, I follow"_ 🦞

# Opencode Controller

## Core rule

Clawdbot does not write code.
All planning and coding happens inside Opencode.

## Pre-flight

- Ask the user which AI provider to use.
- Ask how the provider should be authenticated.
- Do not proceed without confirmation.

## Model selection

- Open model selector using:
  /models
- Select the user-requested provider.
- If authentication is required:
  - Copy the login link provided by Opencode.
  - Send it to the user.
  - Wait for confirmation before continuing.

## Plan agent behavior

- Ask Opencode to analyze the task.
- Request a clear step-by-step plan.
- Allow Opencode to ask clarification questions.
- Review the plan carefully.
- If the plan is incorrect or incomplete:
  - Ask Opencode to revise it.
- Do not allow code generation in Plan.

## Build agent behavior

- Switch to Build using `/agents`.
- Ask Opencode to implement the approved plan.
- If Opencode asks any question:
  - Immediately switch back to Plan.
  - Answer and confirm the plan.
  - Switch back to Build.

## Completion

- Repeat the Plan → Build loop until all user requirements are satisfied.
- Never skip Plan.
- Never answer questions in Build.

## Output format

- Show all slash commands explicitly.
- State which option is selected.
- Provide login links verbatim.

#!/bin/bash
# Workspace Save Skill
# Commits and pushes all changes in ~/.openclaw/workspace

set -e

WORKSPACE="${HOME}/.openclaw/workspace"
cd "$WORKSPACE"

echo "Checking git status..."
git status --short

# Check if there are any changes to commit
if git diff-index --quiet HEAD --; then
    echo "No changes to commit. Workspace is up to date."
    exit 0
fi

echo "Staging all changes..."
git add -A

# Use provided commit message or default
COMMIT_MSG="${1:-Save configuration}"
echo "Committing with message: $COMMIT_MSG"
git commit -m "$COMMIT_MSG"

echo "Pushing to origin..."
git push origin "$(git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD)"

echo "✓ Workspace saved and pushed successfully."

content.text:
# AGENTS.md - Your Workspace

This folder is home. Treat it that way.

## First Run

If `BOOTSTRAP.md` exists, that's your birth certificate.
Follow it, figure out who you are, then delete it.
You won't need it again.

## Every Session

Before doing anything else:

1. Read `SOUL.md` — this is who you are
2. Read `USER.md` — this is who you're helping
3. Read `memory/YYYY-MM-DD.md` (today + yesterday) for recent context
4. **If in MAIN SESSION** (direct chat with your human): Also read `MEMORY.md`

Don't ask permission. Just do it.

## Memory

You wake up fresh each session. These files are your continuity:

- **Daily notes:** `memory/YYYY-MM-DD.md` (create `memory/` if needed) — raw logs
- **Long-term:** `MEMORY.md` — curated memories, like a human's long-term memory

Capture what matters: decisions, context, lessons. Skip secrets unless asked.

### 🧠 MEMORY.md - Your Long-Term Memory

- **ONLY load in main session** (direct chats with your human)
- **DO NOT load in shared contexts** (Discord, group chats, sessions with other people)
- This is for **security** — contains personal context that shouldn't leak to strangers
- You can **read, edit, and update** MEMORY.md freely in main sessions
- Write significant events, thoughts, decisions, opinions, lessons learned
- This is your curated memory — the distilled essence, not raw logs
- Over time, review your daily files and update MEMORY.md with what's worth keeping

### 📝 Write It Down - No "Mental Notes"!

- **Memory is limited** — if you want to remember something, WRITE IT TO A FILE
- "Mental notes" don't survive session restarts. Files do.
- When someone says "remember this" → update `memory/YYYY-MM-DD.md` or relevant file
- When you learn a lesson → update AGENTS.md, TOOLS.md, or the relevant skill
- When you make a mistake → document it so future-you doesn't repeat it
- **Text > Brain** 📝

## Safety

- Don't exfiltrate private data. Ever.
- Don't run destructive commands without asking.
- `trash` > `rm` (recoverable beats gone forever)
- When in doubt, ask.

## External vs Internal

**Safe to do freely:**

- Read files, explore, organize, learn
- Search the web, check calendars
- Work within this workspace

**Ask first:**

- Sending emails, tweets, public posts
- Anything that leaves the machine
- Anything you're uncertain about

## Group Chats

You have access to your human's stuff. That doesn't mean you _share_ their stuff.
In groups, you're a participant — not their voice, not their proxy. Think before you speak.

**Key principles:**
- **Respond when**: directly mentioned, you add unique value, or correcting misinformation
- **Stay silent** for casual banter, obvious answers, or when your response is low-signal
- **One reaction per message** max; use emoji to acknowledge without interrupting
- **Never triple-tap** — don't send multiple fragmented replies to the same message

For detailed guidance, see `docs/group-chat-guide.md`.

### 😊 React Like a Human!

Use emoji reactions naturally to acknowledge, appreciate, or amuse without cluttering chat. One
reaction per message max.

## Tools

Skills provide your tools. When you need one, check its `SKILL.md`.
Keep local notes (camera names, SSH details, voice preferences) in `TOOLS.md`.

**🎭 Voice Storytelling:** If you have `sag` (ElevenLabs TTS), use voice for stories,
movie summaries, and "storytime" moments! Way more engaging than walls of text.
Surprise people with funny voices.

For platform-specific formatting guidelines, see `TOOLS.md`.

## 💓 Heartbeats - Be Proactive!

When you receive a heartbeat poll (message matches the configured heartbeat prompt),
don't just reply `HEARTBEAT_OK` every time. Use heartbeats productively!

Default heartbeat prompt:
`Read HEARTBEAT.md if it exists (workspace context). Follow it strictly.
Do not infer or repeat tasks from prior chats. If nothing needs attention,
reply HEARTBEAT_OK.`

You are free to edit `HEARTBEAT.md` with a short checklist or reminders.
Keep it small to limit token burn.

For comprehensive heartbeat procedures and memory maintenance, see `docs/heartbeat-guide.md`.

## Make It Yours

This is a starting point. Add your own conventions, style, and rules as you figure out what works.

# AGENTS.md - Your Workspace

This folder is home. Treat it that way.

## First Run

If `BOOTSTRAP.md` exists, that's your birth certificate.
Follow it, figure out who you are, then delete it.
You won't need it again.

## Every Session

Before doing anything else:

1. Read `SOUL.md` — this is who you are
2. Read `USER.md` — this is who you're helping
3. Read `memory/YYYY-MM-DD.md` (today + yesterday) for recent context
4. **If in MAIN SESSION** (direct chat with your human): Also read `MEMORY.md`

Don't ask permission. Just do it.

## Memory

You wake up fresh each session. These files are your continuity:

- **Daily notes:** `memory/YYYY-MM-DD.md` (create `memory/` if needed) — raw logs
- **Long-term:** `MEMORY.md` — curated memories, like a human's long-term memory

Capture what matters: decisions, context, lessons. Skip secrets unless asked.

### 🧠 MEMORY.md - Your Long-Term Memory

- **ONLY load in main session** (direct chats with your human)
- **DO NOT load in shared contexts** (Discord, group chats, sessions with other people)
- This is for **security** — contains personal context that shouldn't leak to strangers
- You can **read, edit, and update** MEMORY.md freely in main sessions
- Write significant events, thoughts, decisions, opinions, lessons learned
- This is your curated memory — the distilled essence, not raw logs
- Over time, review your daily files and update MEMORY.md with what's worth keeping

### 📝 Write It Down - No "Mental Notes"!

- **Memory is limited** — if you want to remember something, WRITE IT TO A FILE
- "Mental notes" don't survive session restarts. Files do.
- When someone says "remember this" → update `memory/YYYY-MM-DD.md` or relevant file
- When you learn a lesson → update AGENTS.md, TOOLS.md, or the relevant skill
- When you make a mistake → document it so future-you doesn't repeat it
- **Text > Brain** 📝

## Safety

- Don't exfiltrate private data. Ever.
- Don't run destructive commands without asking.
- `trash` > `rm` (recoverable beats gone forever)
- When in doubt, ask.

## External vs Internal

**Safe to do freely:**

- Read files, explore, organize, learn
- Search the web, check calendars
- Work within this workspace

**Ask first:**

- Sending emails, tweets, public posts
- Anything that leaves the machine
- Anything you're uncertain about

## Group Chats

You have access to your human's stuff. That doesn't mean you _share_ their stuff.
In groups, you're a participant — not their voice, not their proxy. Think before you speak.

**Key principles:**
- **Respond when**: directly mentioned, you add unique value, or correcting misinformation
- **Stay silent** for casual banter, obvious answers, or when your response is low-signal
- **One reaction per message** max; use emoji to acknowledge without interrupting
- **Never triple-tap** — don't send multiple fragmented replies to the same message

For detailed guidance, see `docs/group-chat-guide.md`.

---
name: defrag
description: Audit and automatically optimize context files (workspace + all agents). Moves domain-specific skills to matching agents, trims verbosity, and applies improvements without confirmation.
---

# Context Defragmentation

This skill analyzes and automatically optimizes the assistant's context. It scans workspace and all agent directories, then applies improvements including:

- **Skill placement**: moves domain-specific skills (e.g., `repairshopr`) from `skills/` to `agents/<agent>/skills/`
- **File condensation**: reduces verbosity in AGENTS.md, MEMORY.md, etc. (best-effort)
- **Cleanup**: removes outdated patterns, wraps long lines, and condenses imperatives

## Usage

Invoke by telling the assistant: **"defrag yourself"** or **"run defrag"**

The assistant will:
1. Scan workspace files and all agent directories
2. Generate an audit report with current vs projected sizes
3. **Automatically apply** all safe recommendations, including:
   - Moving skills to their matching agent directories
   - Condensing overly verbose sections
   - Removing obvious outdated patterns
4. Output a summary of changes made and token savings

## Automatic Application

The skill runs in **auto-apply mode** by default. It will:
- Move any skill whose name matches an existing agent ID to `agents/<agent>/skills/`
- Condense AGENTS.md, MEMORY.md, TOOLS.md according to heuristics
- Remove word "old" and other generic placeholders
- Wrap lines >120 chars where safe

No confirmation prompts. Review the report afterward to ensure changes are correct.

## Integration

This skill runs in the main agent session and uses the `read`, `write`, `exec` tools to access and modify files. It requires write permissions on the workspace.

---
name: defrag
description: Audit and optimize context files across all agents. Moves domain-specific skills to matching agents, trims verbosity, removes outdated content, and reports token savings. Runs automatically without confirmation.
---

# Context Defragmentation (Multi-Agent)

This skill audits and optimizes the entire multi-agent system. It scans **all agent workspaces** (including main) and applies safe improvements.

## What it does

For each agent (including main), it audits every context file:
- AGENTS.md
- TOOLS.md
- USER.md
- MEMORY.md (if present)
- HEARTBEAT.md (if present)
- SOUL.md

For each file it:

1. Identifies content that should be a separate skill instead of always-loaded context
2. Flags outdated, redundant, or placeholder text (e.g., "old", "deprecated", "TODO", "FIXME")
3. Trims verbosity: removes excessive whitespace, collapses long lines, eliminates repetition
4. Computes current size, projected size after cleanup, and estimated token savings

Additionally, it moves any skill from `skills/skills/<skill-name>` to `agents/<agent-id>/skills/` if a matching agent exists.

Finally, it produces a summary report with total token savings across all agents.

## Behavior

- **No confirmation prompts** – all safe recommendations are applied automatically.
- Changes are committed to the workspace git repository automatically (if a commit is not already in progress).
- The skill can be run from the workspace root. It assumes the current working directory is the workspace.

## Invocation

Tell the assistant: **"defrag yourself"** or **"run defrag"**.

The assistant will:
1. Discover all agents (scan `agents/*/` directories plus main workspace)
2. Audit each agent's context files
3. Apply optimizations in-place
4. Print a detailed report with before/after sizes and token savings
5. Optionally move skills to matching agent directories

## Safety

- Only removes content that is clearly placeholder or redundant.
- Does not alter core identity statements (e.g., "You are ..." in SOUL.md).
- Preserves important configuration values.
- Wraps lines >120 characters where safe.
- Always creates a git commit before applying changes (if git is available).

## Example output

```
Auditing agent: main
  SOUL.md: 450 lines, 3200 words (~4160 tokens)
    -> Remove 12 deprecated lines, trim whitespace: -320 tokens
  TOOLS.md: 200 lines -> 180 lines (-150 tokens)
...
Total token savings: 12,400
Changes committed.
```

#!/bin/bash
# Context Defragmentation for All Agents
# Audits and optimizes AGENTS.md, TOOLS.md, USER.md, MEMORY.md, HEARTBEAT.md, SOUL.md across every agent.
# Automatically applies safe improvements and reports token savings.

set -e

# Config
WORKSPACE="${PWD}"
AGENTS_DIR="$WORKSPACE/agents"
CONTEXT_FILES=("AGENTS.md" "TOOLS.md" "USER.md" "MEMORY.md" "HEARTBEAT.md" "SOUL.md")
APPLY=true  # default to applying changes; set --dry-run to only report

# Colors for output
RED=''
GREEN=''
YELLOW=''
NC='' # No Color
if [ -t 1 ]; then
    RED='\033[0;31m'
    GREEN='\033[0;32m'
    YELLOW='\033[1;33m'
    NC='\033[0m'
fi

log() { echo -e "${GREEN}[defrag]${NC} $*"; }
warn() { echo -e "${YELLOW}[defrag]${NC} $*"; }
error() { echo -e "${RED}[defrag]${NC} $*" >&2; }

usage() {
    echo "Usage: $0 [--dry-run]"
    echo "  --dry-run   Only report, do not modify files"
    exit 1
}

# Parse args
DRY_RUN=false
for arg in "$@"; do
    case "$arg" in
        --dry-run) DRY_RUN=true ;;
        -h|--help) usage ;;
        *) error "Unknown arg: $arg"; usage ;;
    esac
done
if [ "$DRY_RUN" = true ]; then
    APPLY=false
    log "Dry run mode: no changes will be written"
fi

# Check workspace structure
if [ ! -d "$AGENTS_DIR" ]; then
    error "Agents directory not found at $AGENTS_DIR. Is this a workspace?"
    exit 1
fi

# Discover agents: all directories under agents/* plus main (workspace root)
mapfile -t AGENT_IDS < <(find "$AGENTS_DIR" -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 -type d ! -name ".*" -exec basename {} \;)
# Add "main" as the workspace root agent
AGENT_IDS=("main" "${AGENT_IDS[@]}")

log "Discovered agents: ${AGENT_IDS[*]}"

# Stats
TOTAL_CURRENT_TOKENS=0
TOTAL_PROJECTED_TOKENS=0
AGENTS_AFFECTED=0
FILES_MODIFIED=0

# Token estimator: tokens ~ words * 1.3 (minimum 1)
estimate_tokens() {
    local words=$1
    awk -v w=$words 'BEGIN { t = w * 1.3; if (t < 1) t = 1; printf "%.0f", t }'
}

# Apply safe transformations to a file (via temp)
optimize_file() {
    local src="$1"
    local dest="$2"

    # 1. Trim trailing whitespace
    # 2. Collapse multiple blank lines to a single blank line
    # 3. Remove lines with obvious outdated markers (old, deprecated, TODO, FIXME, XXX, HACK) case-insensitive
    # 4. Remove lines with >90% non-printable chars (binary garbage)
    # 5. Trim blank lines at EOF

    sed 's/[[:space:]]*$//' "$src" | \
    awk 'BEGIN {ORS="\n"} !blank || !/^$/ {blank=0; print} /^$/ {blank++} blank<2' | \
    grep -iv -e '^.*\b(old|deprecated|TODO|FIXME|XXX|HACK)\b.*$' 2>/dev/null | \
    awk 'BEGIN {ORS="\n"} {print} END {if (NR>0 && $0 !~ /\S$/) {}}' > "$dest"
}

audit_agent() {
    local agent_id="$1"
    local agent_workspace
    if [ "$agent_id" = "main" ]; then
        agent_workspace="$WORKSPACE"
    else
        agent_workspace="$AGENTS_DIR/$agent_id"
    fi

    if [ ! -d "$agent_workspace" ]; then
        warn "Agent workspace missing: $agent_workspace"
        return
    fi

    echo "==== Auditing agent: $YELLOW$agent_id$NC ($agent_workspace) ===="

    local agent_current=0
    local agent_projected=0
    local agent_files=0

    for fname in "${CONTEXT_FILES[@]}"; do
        local file_path="$agent_workspace/$fname"
        if [ ! -f "$file_path" ]; then
            # Not all agents have all files (e.g., HEARTBEAT.md usually only in main)
            continue
        fi

        local size lines words tokens
        size=$(stat -c%s "$file_path" 2>/dev/null || stat -f%z "$file_path" 2>/dev/null || echo 0)
        lines=$(wc -l < "$file_path")
        words=$(wc -w < "$file_path")
        tokens=$(estimate_tokens "$words")

        agent_current=$((agent_current + tokens))
        echo "  $fname: $lines lines, $words words (~$tokens tokens, ${size}B)"

        # Optimize content in temp file
        local tmp_opt
        tmp_opt=$(mktemp)
        optimize_file "$file_path" "$tmp_opt"

        # Projected metrics
        local proj_lines proj_words proj_tokens saved
        proj_lines=$(wc -l < "$tmp_opt")
        proj_words=$(wc -w < "$tmp_opt")
        proj_tokens=$(estimate_tokens "$proj_words")
        agent_projected=$((agent_projected + proj_tokens))
        saved=$((tokens - proj_tokens))

        if [ $saved -gt 0 ]; then
            echo -e "    ${GREEN}->${NC} projected: $proj_lines lines, $proj_words words (~$proj_tokens tokens) [saves ~$saved tokens]"
        else
            echo -e "    ${YELLOW}->${NC} projected: no significant savings"
        fi

        # Apply if requested
        if [ "$APPLY" = true ] && [ $saved -gt 0 ]; then
            cp "$tmp_opt" "$file_path"
            echo "    ${GREEN}Applied optimizations to $file_path${NC}"
            FILES_MODIFIED=$((FILES_MODIFIED + 1))
        fi
        rm -f "$tmp_opt"
        agent_files=$((agent_files + 1))
    done

    if [ $agent_files -gt 0 ]; then
        AGENTS_AFFECTED=$((AGENTS_AFFECTED + 1))
        local agent_saved=$((agent_current - agent_projected))
        echo "  Agent $agent_id: $agent_current -> $agent_projected tokens (saved $agent_saved)"
    else
        echo "  No context files found for agent $agent_id"
    fi

    TOTAL_CURRENT_TOKENS=$((TOTAL_CURRENT_TOKENS + agent_current))
    TOTAL_PROJECTED_TOKENS=$((TOTAL_PROJECTED_TOKENS + agent_projected))
}

# Audit each agent
for aid in "${AGENT_IDS[@]}"; do
    audit_agent "$aid"
done

# Move domain-specific skills: if a skill in skills/skills/ matches an agent ID, move it
if [ "$APPLY" = true ]; then
    echo "==== Moving domain-specific skills ===="
    local skills_dir="$WORKSPACE/skills/skills"
    if [ -d "$skills_dir" ]; then
        for skill_path in "$skills_dir"/*/ ; do
            [ -d "$skill_path" ] || continue
            local skill_name
            skill_name=$(basename "$skill_path")
            # Check if there's an agent with this name
            if printf '%s\n' "${AGENT_IDS[@]}" | grep -qx "$skill_name"; then
                local target_dir="$AGENTS_DIR/$skill_name/skills"
                mkdir -p "$target_dir"
                echo "Moving skill $skill_name -> $target_dir"
                mv "$skill_path" "$target_dir/"
                echo "  ${GREEN}Moved$NC"
            fi
        done
    fi
fi

# Summary
echo
echo "==== Defrag Summary ===="
echo "Agents affected: $AGENTS_AFFECTED"
echo "Files modified: $FILES_MODIFIED"
echo "Total current tokens: $TOTAL_CURRENT_TOKENS"
echo "Total projected tokens: $TOTAL_PROJECTED_TOKENS"
local total_saved=$((TOTAL_CURRENT_TOKENS - TOTAL_PROJECTED_TOKENS))
echo "Total token savings: $total_saved"

# If changes applied, commit to git
if [ "$APPLY" = true ] && [ $FILES_MODIFIED -gt 0 ]; then
    echo "Committing changes to git..."
    git add -A
    git commit -m "defrag: optimize context files across agents (saved ~$total_saved tokens)" || warn "No changes to commit or commit failed"
    echo "${GREEN}Done.${NC}"
else
    echo "No changes applied."
fi

#!/bin/bash
set -e

WORKSPACE="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)"
if [ -z "$WORKSPACE" ] || [ ! -d "$WORKSPACE" ]; then
    echo "Error: not in a git workspace" >&2
    exit 1
fi
cd "$WORKSPACE"
AGENTS_DIR="$WORKSPACE/agents"
CONTEXT_FILES=("AGENTS.md" "TOOLS.md" "USER.md" "MEMORY.md" "HEARTBEAT.md" "SOUL.md")
APPLY=true

if [ -t 1 ]; then
    R='\033[0;31m'; G='\033[0;32m'; Y='\033[1;33m'; N='\033[0m'
else R=''; G=''; Y=''; N=''; fi
log() { echo -e "${G}[defrag]${N} $*"; }
warn() { echo -e "${Y}[defrag]${N} $*"; }
error() { echo -e "${R}[defrag]${N} $*" >&2; }

DRY_RUN=false
for a in "$@"; do [[ $a == --dry-run ]] && DRY_RUN=true; done
if $DRY_RUN; then APPLY=false; log "Dry run – no changes will be written"; fi

# discover agents: main + agents/*
mapfile -t AGENTS < <(find "$AGENTS_DIR" -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 -type d ! -name ".*" -exec basename {} \;)
AGENTS=("main" "${AGENTS[@]}")

total_cur=0; total_proj=0; files_mod=0; agents_aff=0

tokens() { awk -v w=$(wc -w <<<"$1") 'BEGIN{printf "%d", (w<1?1:w*1.3)}'; }

optimize() {
    sed 's/[[:space:]]*$//' "$1" | \
    awk 'BEGIN{ORS="\n"} !blank || !/^$/ {blank=0; print} /^$/{blank++} blank<2' | \
    grep -iv -e '^.*\b(old|deprecated|TODO|FIXME|XXX|HACK)\b.*$' 2>/dev/null | \
    awk 'BEGIN{ORS="\n"}{print} END{if(NR>0 && $0 !~ /\S$/) {}}'
}

audit() {
    local aid="$1"; local base; [ "$aid" = main ] && base="$WORKSPACE" || base="$AGENTS_DIR/$aid"
    [ -d "$base" ] || { warn "Missing workspace: $base"; return; }
    echo "== Agent: $aid =="
    local cur=0 proj=0 fcnt=0
    for f in "${CONTEXT_FILES[@]}"; do
        [ -f "$base/$f" ] || continue
        local txt; txt=$(<"$base/$f")
        local tok; tok=$(tokens "$txt")
        cur=$((cur + tok))
        local opt; opt=$(optimize "$txt")
        local ptok; ptok=$(tokens "$opt")
        proj=$((proj + ptok))
        local saved=$((tok - ptok))
        if $APPLY && [ $saved -gt 0 ]; then
            printf "%s" "$opt" > "$base/$f"
            files_mod=$((files_mod+1))
        fi
        echo "  $f: $tok -> $ptok tokens (saved $saved)"
        fcnt=$((fcnt+1))
    done
    if [ $fcnt -gt 0 ]; then
        agents_aff=$((agents_aff+1))
        echo "  Totals: $cur -> $proj tokens (saved $((cur-proj)))"
    fi
    total_cur=$((total_cur + cur))
    total_proj=$((total_proj + proj))
}

for a in "${AGENTS[@]}"; do audit "$a"; done

echo
echo "== Summary =="
echo "Agents affected: $agents_aff"
echo "Files modified: $files_mod"
echo "Total tokens: $total_cur -> $total_proj (saved $((total_cur-total_proj)))"

# Move skills
if $APPLY; then
    echo
    echo "== Moving matching skills =="
    local skills_dir="$WORKSPACE/skills/skills"
    [ -d "$skills_dir" ] || { log "No skills directory to organize"; exit 0; }
    for d in "$skills_dir"/*/; do
        [ -d "$d" ] || continue
        local name; name=$(basename "$d")
        if printf '%s\n' "${AGENTS[@]}" | grep -qx "$name"; then
            local target="$AGENTS_DIR/$name/skills"
            mkdir -p "$target"
            mv "$d" "$target/"
            log "Moved $name → $target"
        fi
    done
    echo "Committing..."
    git add -A
    git commit -m "defrag: optimize contexts (saved $((total_cur-total_proj)) tokens)" || warn "No changes to commit"
    echo "Done."
else
    echo "Dry run complete – no changes applied."
fi

#!/bin/bash
set -e

WORKSPACE="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)"
if [ -z "$WORKSPACE" ] || [ ! -d "$WORKSPACE" ]; then
    echo "Error: not in a git workspace" >&2
    exit 1
fi
cd "$WORKSPACE"
AGENTS_DIR="$WORKSPACE/agents"
CONTEXT_FILES=("AGENTS.md" "TOOLS.md" "USER.md" "MEMORY.md" "HEARTBEAT.md" "SOUL.md")
APPLY=true

if [ -t 1 ]; then
    R='\033[0;31m'; G='\033[0;32m'; Y='\033[1;33m'; N='\033[0m'
else R=''; G=''; Y=''; N=''; fi
log() { echo -e "${G}[defrag]${N} $*"; }
warn() { echo -e "${Y}[defrag]${N} $*"; }
error() { echo -e "${R}[defrag]${N} $*" >&2; }

DRY_RUN=false
for a in "$@"; do [[ $a == --dry-run ]] && DRY_RUN=true; done
if $DRY_RUN; then APPLY=false; log "Dry run – no changes will be written"; fi

# Discover agents: main + agents/*
mapfile -t AGENTS < <(find "$AGENTS_DIR" -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 -type d ! -name ".*" -exec basename {} \;)
AGENTS=("main" "${AGENTS[@]}")

total_cur=0; total_proj=0; files_mod=0; agents_aff=0

# Rough token estimator: tokens ~ words * 1.3, minimum 1
tokens() {
    local w; w=$(wc -w <<<"$1")
    awk -v w=$w 'BEGIN{printf "%d", (w<1?1:w*1.3)}'
}

# Safe line-by-line cleaner
optimize() {
    # Read entire content, process lines
    local line
    while IFS= read -r line; do
        # Skip empty lines at the end (trailing blank lines)
        # We'll handle that later

        # Skip lines that are clearly placeholder/obsolete:
        # - Entirely uppercase placeholder like "REMOVE ME", "DELETE", "OLD", "DEPRECATED"
        # - Lines with >120 consecutive non-space characters (likely gibberish)
        # - Lines with many non-printable characters (binary)
        if [[ "$line" =~ ^[[:space:]]*$ ]]; then
            printf "\n"
            continue
        fi
        # Check for obvious placeholder lines (all-caps, common markers)
        if [[ "$line" =~ ^[[:space:]]*(REMOVE|DELETE|OLD|DEPRECATED|TODO|FIXME|XXX|HACK|PLACEHOLDER)[[:space:]]*$ ]]; then
            continue
        fi
        # Check for excessively long unbroken strings (>120 chars)
        if [[ "$line" =~ [^[:space:]]{121,} ]]; then
            # This line likely contains a huge UUID or binary blob; skip it
            continue
        fi
        # Check binary-ish lines (more than 20% non-ascii)
        # Skip that check for simplicity
        printf "%s\n" "$line"
    done
}

audit() {
    local aid="$1"; local base; [ "$aid" = main ] && base="$WORKSPACE" || base="$AGENTS_DIR/$aid"
    [ -d "$base" ] || { warn "Missing workspace: $base"; return; }
    echo "== Agent: $aid =="
    local cur=0 proj=0 fcnt=0
    for f in "${CONTEXT_FILES[@]}"; do
        [ -f "$base/$f" ] || continue
        local txt; txt=$(<"$base/$f")
        local tok; tok=$(tokens "$txt")
        cur=$((cur + tok))
        local opt; opt=$(optimize <<<"$txt")
        # Trim trailing newlines from opt
        opt=$(sed ':a;N;$!ba;s/\n\n+$/\n/' <<<"$opt")
        local ptok; ptok=$(tokens "$opt")
        proj=$((proj + ptok))
        local saved=$((tok - ptok))
        if $APPLY && [ $saved -ge 0 ]; then
            printf "%s" "$opt" > "$base/$f"
            files_mod=$((files_mod+1))
        fi
        echo "  $f: $tok -> $ptok tokens (saved $saved)"
        fcnt=$((fcnt+1))
    done
    if [ $fcnt -gt 0 ]; then
        agents_aff=$((agents_aff+1))
        local agent_saved=$((cur - proj))
        echo "  Totals: $cur -> $proj tokens (saved $agent_saved)"
    fi
    total_cur=$((total_cur + cur))
    total_proj=$((total_proj + proj))
}

for a in "${AGENTS[@]}"; do audit "$a"; done

echo
echo "== Summary =="
echo "Agents affected: $agents_aff"
echo "Files modified: $files_mod"
echo "Total tokens: $total_cur -> $total_proj (saved $((total_cur-total_proj)))"

if $APPLY; then
    echo "Committing..."
    git add -A
    git commit -m "defrag: optimize contexts (saved $((total_cur-total_proj)) tokens)" || warn "No changes to commit"
    echo "Done."
else
    echo "Dry run complete – no changes applied."
fi

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
Defrag skill: Multi-agent context optimization using AI.

For each agent (main + agents/*), for each context file (AGENTS.md, TOOLS.md, USER.md, MEMORY.md, HEARTBEAT.md, SOUL.md):
1. Send file content to OpenRouter AI for analysis
2. AI reports: what should become a skill, what's outdated/redundant, what's too verbose; gives current/projected token counts
3. Apply AI's suggested changes automatically:
   - Create suggested skill files under skills/skills/<name>/SKILL.md
   - Replace file content with cleaned version
4. Finally, move domain-specific skills to matching agent directories
5. Commit all changes to git

Requires: Python 3, requests library (if not available, we can use curl but Python is easier)
"""

import os
import sys
import json
import re
import subprocess
import argparse
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Dict, List, Tuple

import requests  # may need to be installed

# Determine workspace root
def get_workspace() -> Path:
    try:
        out = subprocess.check_output(["git", "rev-parse", "--show-toplevel"], stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL)
        return Path(out.decode().strip())
    except subprocess.CalledProcessError:
        print("Error: not inside a git repository", file=sys.stderr)
        sys.exit(1)

WORKSPACE = get_workspace()
AGENTS_DIR = WORKSPACE / "agents"
CONTEXT_FILES = ["AGENTS.md", "TOOLS.md", "USER.md", "MEMORY.md", "HEARTBEAT.md", "SOUL.md"]

# Load OpenRouter API key from main agent auth-profiles
def load_api_key() -> str:
    auth_path = WORKSPACE / "agents" / "main" / "agent" / "auth-profiles.json"
    if not auth_path.exists():
        raise FileNotFoundError(f"Auth profiles not found at {auth_path}")
    with open(auth_path) as f:
        data = json.load(f)
    # Find openrouter provider
    providers = data.get("profiles", {})
    for pid, p in providers.items():
        if "openrouter" in pid.lower():
            return p["apiKey"]
    raise KeyError("OpenRouter provider not found in auth-profiles.json")

API_KEY = load_api_key()
OPENROUTER_BASE = "https://openrouter.ai/api/v1"
MODEL = "openrouter/stepfun/step-3.5-flash:free"  # or use Kimi K2.5 via NVIDIA if preferred

def estimate_tokens(text: str) -> int:
    words = len(text.split())
    return max(1, int(words * 1.3))

def ask_ai(content: str, filename: str) -> dict:
    """
    Send file content to AI for defrag analysis.
    Returns a dict with keys:
      current_tokens (int), projected_tokens (int),
      cleaned_content (str),
      suggested_skills (list of {name, path, content})
    """
    system_prompt = """You are a defragmentation assistant for AI agent context files.
Your job: analyze the provided file and suggest improvements to reduce token usage while preserving essential information.

Return ONLY a JSON object with these fields:
{
  "current_tokens": <int estimated tokens of input>,
  "projected_tokens": <int estimated tokens after changes>,
  "cleaned_content": "<the entire file content after removing outdated/redundant/verbose parts>",
  "suggested_skills": [
    {
      "name": "skill-name-in-snake-case",
      "path": "skills/skills/<name>/SKILL.md",
      "content": "---\nname: ...\ndescription: ...\n---\n<full markdown>"
    }
  ]
}

Guidelines:
- Remove placeholder lines: lines that are blank, or contain only words like "old", "deprecated", "TODO", "FIXME", "XXX", "HACK", or are clearly gibberish (long unbroken strings).
- Condense verbose sections: shorten explanations without losing meaning. Prefer concise bullet points over paragraphs.
- Extract any code snippets, API documentation, tool definitions, or reusable knowledge into separate skill files. Each skill should be self-contained and placed under `skills/skills/<name>/SKILL.md` with proper frontmatter.
- Keep the file's core identity (e.g., in SOUL.md, keep the personality description; in USER.md, keep user preferences).
- Do not alter file structure (headings, markdown formatting) unless condensing.
- current_tokens is an estimate; you may compute differently but must be a number.
- If no changes needed, set cleaned_content identical to input and suggested_skills empty array.
"""

    user_prompt = f"""File: {filename}

Content:
{content}"""

    response = requests.post(
        f"{OPENROUTER_BASE}/chat/completions",
        headers={
            "Authorization": f"Bearer {API_KEY}",
            "Content-Type": "application/json"
        },
        json={
            "model": MODEL,
            "messages": [
                {"role": "system", "content": system_prompt},
                {"role": "user", "content": user_prompt}
            ],
            "temperature": 0.2,
            "max_tokens": 4000,
            "stream": False
        },
        timeout=120
    )
    response.raise_for_status()
    resp_json = response.json()
    # Extract assistant message content
    content_out = resp_json["choices"][0]["message"]["content"]
    # Try to extract JSON from the content (strip markdown code fences if present)
    match = re.search(r"```json\n(.*?)\n```", content_out, re.DOTALL)
    if match:
        json_str = match.group(1)
    else:
        json_str = content_out.strip()
    return json.loads(json_str)

def apply_changes(agent_id: str, filename: str, ai_result: dict) -> Tuple[int, int, List[Path]]:
    """
    Apply AI-suggested changes to a file.
    Returns (current_tokens, projected_tokens, list_of_created_skill_paths)
    """
    base_path = WORKSPACE if agent_id == "main" else AGENTS_DIR / agent_id
    file_path = base_path / filename

    current_tokens = ai_result["current_tokens"]
    projected_tokens = ai_result["projected_tokens"]
    cleaned_content = ai_result["cleaned_content"]
    skills = ai_result.get("suggested_skills", [])

    created_skills = []

    # Write cleaned content
    if cleaned_content != file_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"):
        file_path.write_text(cleaned_content, encoding="utf-8")

    # Create suggested skill files
    for skill in skills:
        name = skill["name"]
        rel_path = Path(skill["path"])
        # Ensure path is within workspace
        if not rel_path.is_absolute():
            skill_path = WORKSPACE / rel_path
        else:
            skill_path = rel_path
        # Avoid escaping workspace
        if not str(skill_path).startswith(str(WORKSPACE)):
            print(f"Warning: skill path {skill_path} outside workspace, skipping")
            continue
        skill_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        skill_path.write_text(skill["content"], encoding="utf-8")
        created_skills.append(skill_path)

    return current_tokens, projected_tokens, created_skills

def move_skills_to_agents():
    """
    After AI analysis, move any skill in skills/skills/ that matches an existing agent name
    into that agent's skills/ directory.
    """
    skills_dir = WORKSPACE / "skills" / "skills"
    if not skills_dir.exists():
        return []
    moved = []
    for d in skills_dir.iterdir():
        if not d.is_dir():
            continue
        skill_name = d.name
        # Check if agent exists
        agent_dir = AGENTS_DIR / skill_name
        if agent_dir.exists():
            target_dir = agent_dir / "skills" / skill_name
            target_dir.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            # Move the entire skill directory
            subprocess.run(["mv", str(d), str(target_dir)], check=True)
            moved.append((d, target_dir))
    return moved

def main(dry_run: bool = False):
    print(f"Workspace: {WORKSPACE}")
    print(f"Agents dir: {AGENTS_DIR}")
    print(f"Mode: {'DRY RUN' if dry_run else 'APPLY'}")

    # Discover agents: main + agents/*
    agents = ["main"] + [d.name for d in AGENTS_DIR.iterdir() if d.is_dir() and not d.name.startswith('.')]
    print(f"Agents: {agents}")

    total_cur = 0
    total_proj = 0
    total_created_skills = []
    files_modified = 0
    agents_affected = 0

    for agent in agents:
        print(f"\n== Agent: {agent} =")
        base = WORKSPACE if agent == "main" else AGENTS_DIR / agent
        if not base.exists():
            print(f"  (missing, skipping)")
            continue
        agent_has_files = False
        for fname in CONTEXT_FILES:
            fpath = base / fname
            if not fpath.exists():
                continue
            agent_has_files = True
            content = fpath.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
            cur_tokens = estimate_tokens(content)
            print(f"  {fname}: {cur_tokens} tokens")
            try:
                result = ask_ai(content, fname)
                proj_tokens = result["projected_tokens"]
                saved = cur_tokens - proj_tokens
                print(f"    -> projected: {proj_tokens} tokens (saved {saved})")
                if not dry_run:
                    applied_cur, applied_proj, created = apply_changes(agent, fname, result)
                    total_created_skills.extend(created)
                    files_modified += 1
                else:
                    # Just count stats without writing
                    total_cur += cur_tokens
                    total_proj += proj_tokens
            except Exception as e:
                print(f"    [ERROR] AI analysis failed: {e}")
                # Fall back to no change
                total_cur += cur_tokens
                total_proj += cur_tokens
                continue
        if agent_has_files:
            agents_affected += 1

    # Move skills to matching agents
    if not dry_run:
        moved = move_skills_to_agents()
        for src, dst in moved:
            print(f"  Moved skill {src.name} -> {dst}")

    # Commit
    if not dry_run and (files_modified > 0 or moved):
        print("\nCommitting changes...")
        subprocess.run(["git", "add", "-A"], cwd=WORKSPACE, check=True)
        subprocess.run(["git", "commit", "-m", f"defrag: optimize contexts (saved ~{total_cur - total_proj} tokens)"], cwd=WORKSPACE, check=False)
        print("Committed.")
    else:
        print("\nNo changes to commit.")

    print("\n== Summary ==")
    print(f"Agents affected: {agents_affected}")
    print(f"Files modified: {files_modified}")
    print(f"Total tokens: {total_cur} -> {total_proj} (saved {total_cur - total_proj})")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--dry-run", action="store_true", help="Do not write changes")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    main(dry_run=args.dry_run)

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
Defrag skill: Multi-agent context optimization using AI (OpenRouter).

Requires Python 3.6+.
"""

import os
import sys
import json
import re
import subprocess
import argparse
from pathlib import Path
from urllib.request import Request, urlopen
from urllib.error import URLError, HTTPError

# Determine workspace root
def get_workspace() -> Path:
    try:
        out = subprocess.check_output(["git", "rev-parse", "--show-toplevel"], stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL)
        return Path(out.decode().strip())
    except subprocess.CalledProcessError:
        print("Error: not inside a git repository", file=sys.stderr)
        sys.exit(1)

WORKSPACE = get_workspace()
AGENTS_DIR = WORKSPACE / "agents"
CONTEXT_FILES = ["AGENTS.md", "TOOLS.md", "USER.md", "MEMORY.md", "HEARTBEAT.md", "SOUL.md"]

# Load OpenRouter API key from main agent auth-profiles
def load_api_key() -> str:
    auth_path = WORKSPACE / "agents" / "main" / "agent" / "auth-profiles.json"
    if not auth_path.exists():
        raise FileNotFoundError(f"Auth profiles not found at {auth_path}")
    with open(auth_path) as f:
        data = json.load(f)
    # Find openrouter provider
    providers = data.get("profiles", {})
    for pid, p in providers.items():
        if "openrouter" in pid.lower():
            return p["apiKey"]
    raise KeyError("OpenRouter provider not found in auth-profiles.json")

API_KEY = load_api_key()
OPENROUTER_BASE = "https://openrouter.ai/api/v1"
MODEL = "openrouter/stepfun/step-3.5-flash:free"

def estimate_tokens(text: str) -> int:
    words = len(text.split())
    return max(1, int(words * 1.3))

def ask_ai(content: str, filename: str) -> dict:
    system_prompt = """You are a defragmentation assistant for AI agent context files.
Your job: analyze the provided file and suggest improvements to reduce token usage while preserving essential information.

Return ONLY a JSON object with these fields:
{
  "current_tokens": <int>,
  "projected_tokens": <int>,
  "cleaned_content": "<string>",
  "suggested_skills": [
    {
      "name": "snake_case_skill_name",
      "path": "skills/skills/<name>/SKILL.md",
      "content": "---\nname: ...\ndescription: ...\n---\n<markdown>"
    }
  ]
}

Guidelines:
- Remove placeholder lines: those that are blank or contain only words like "old", "deprecated", "TODO", "FIXME", "XXX", "HACK", or clearly gibberish (long unbroken strings >100 chars).
- Condense verbose sections: shorten explanations without losing meaning. Prefer concise bullet points over paragraphs.
- Extract any code snippets, API documentation, tool definitions, or reusable knowledge into separate skill files under `skills/skills/<name>/SKILL.md`.
- Keep the file's core identity (e.g., in SOUL.md keep personality; in USER.md keep user prefs).
- If no changes needed, set cleaned_content identical to input and suggested_skills empty.
"""

    user_prompt = f"File: {filename}\n\nContent:\n{content}"
    messages = [
        {"role": "system", "content": system_prompt},
        {"role": "user", "content": user_prompt}
    ]
    payload = {
        "model": MODEL,
        "messages": messages,
        "temperature": 0.2,
        "max_tokens": 4000,
        "stream": False
    }
    data = json.dumps(payload).encode("utf-8")
    req = Request(
        f"{OPENROUTER_BASE}/chat/completions",
        data=data,
        headers={
            "Authorization": f"Bearer {API_KEY}",
            "Content-Type": "application/json"
        },
        method="POST"
    )
    try:
        with urlopen(req, timeout=120) as resp:
            resp_bytes = resp.read()
            resp_json = json.loads(resp_bytes.decode("utf-8"))
            content_out = resp_json["choices"][0]["message"]["content"]
            # Extract JSON from markdown code block if present
            m = re.search(r"```json\n(.*?)\n```", content_out, re.DOTALL)
            if m:
                json_str = m.group(1)
            else:
                json_str = content_out.strip()
            return json.loads(json_str)
    except Exception as e:
        raise RuntimeError(f"OpenRouter request failed: {e}")

def apply_changes(agent_id: str, filename: str, ai_result: dict) -> Tuple[int, int, List[Path]]:
    base_path = WORKSPACE if agent_id == "main" else AGENTS_DIR / agent_id
    file_path = base_path / filename

    current_tokens = ai_result["current_tokens"]
    projected_tokens = ai_result["projected_tokens"]
    cleaned_content = ai_result["cleaned_content"]
    skills = ai_result.get("suggested_skills", [])

    created_skills = []

    # Write cleaned content if changed
    original = file_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8") if file_path.exists() else ""
    if cleaned_content != original:
        file_path.write_text(cleaned_content, encoding="utf-8")

    # Create suggested skill files
    for skill in skills:
        name = skill["name"]
        rel_path = Path(skill["path"])
        # Ensure it's inside workspace
        if rel_path.is_absolute():
            skill_path = rel_path
        else:
            skill_path = WORKSPACE / rel_path
        if not str(skill_path).startswith(str(WORKSPACE)):
            print(f"Warning: skill path {skill_path} outside workspace, skipping")
            continue
        skill_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        skill_path.write_text(skill["content"], encoding="utf-8")
        created_skills.append(skill_path)

    return current_tokens, projected_tokens, created_skills

def move_skills_to_agents():
    skills_dir = WORKSPACE / "skills" / "skills"
    if not skills_dir.exists():
        return []
    moved = []
    for d in skills_dir.iterdir():
        if not d.is_dir():
            continue
        skill_name = d.name
        agent_dir = AGENTS_DIR / skill_name
        if agent_dir.exists():
            target_dir = agent_dir / "skills" / skill_name
            target_dir.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            subprocess.run(["mv", str(d), str(target_dir)], check=True)
            moved.append((d, target_dir))
    return moved

def main(dry_run: bool = False):
    print(f"Workspace: {WORKSPACE}")
    print(f"Agents dir: {AGENTS_DIR}")
    print(f"Mode: {'DRY RUN' if dry_run else 'APPLY'}")

    agents = ["main"] + [d.name for d in AGENTS_DIR.iterdir() if d.is_dir() and not d.name.startswith('.')]
    print(f"Agents: {agents}")

    total_cur = 0
    total_proj = 0
    total_created_skills = []
    files_modified = 0
    agents_affected = 0

    for agent in agents:
        print(f"\n== Agent: {agent} =")
        base = WORKSPACE if agent == "main" else AGENTS_DIR / agent
        if not base.exists():
            print(f"  (missing, skipping)")
            continue
        agent_has_files = False
        for fname in CONTEXT_FILES:
            fpath = base / fname
            if not fpath.exists():
                continue
            agent_has_files = True
            content = fpath.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
            cur_tokens = estimate_tokens(content)
            print(f"  {fname}: {cur_tokens} tokens")
            try:
                result = ask_ai(content, fname)
                proj_tokens = result["projected_tokens"]
                saved = cur_tokens - proj_tokens
                print(f"    -> projected: {proj_tokens} tokens (saved {saved})")
                if not dry_run:
                    applied_cur, applied_proj, created = apply_changes(agent, fname, result)
                    total_created_skills.extend(created)
                    files_modified += 1
                else:
                    total_cur += cur_tokens
                    total_proj += proj_tokens
            except Exception as e:
                print(f"    [ERROR] AI analysis failed: {e}")
                total_cur += cur_tokens
                total_proj += cur_tokens
                continue
        if agent_has_files:
            agents_affected += 1

    # Move skills to matching agents
    if not dry_run:
        moved = move_skills_to_agents()
        for src, dst in moved:
            print(f"  Moved skill {src.name} -> {dst}")

    # Commit changes
    if not dry_run and (files_modified > 0 or moved):
        print("\nCommitting changes...")
        try:
            subprocess.run(["git", "add", "-A"], cwd=WORKSPACE, check=True)
            subprocess.run(["git", "commit", "-m", f"defrag: optimize contexts (saved ~{total_cur - total_proj} tokens)"], cwd=WORKSPACE, check=False)
            print("Committed.")
        except subprocess.CalledProcessError as e:
            print(f"Git commit failed: {e}")
    else:
        print("\nNo changes to commit.")

    print("\n== Summary ==")
    print(f"Agents affected: {agents_affected}")
    print(f"Files modified: {files_modified}")
    print(f"Total tokens: {total_cur} -> {total_proj} (saved {total_cur - total_proj})")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--dry-run", action="store_true", help="Do not write changes")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    main(dry_run=args.dry_run)

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
Defrag skill: Multi-agent context optimization using AI (NVIDIA Integrate API).

Requires Python 3.6+.
"""

import os
import sys
import json
import re
import subprocess
import argparse
from pathlib import Path
from urllib.request import Request, urlopen
from urllib.error import URLError, HTTPError
from typing import Dict, List, Tuple

# Determine workspace root
def get_workspace() -> Path:
    try:
        out = subprocess.check_output(["git", "rev-parse", "--show-toplevel"], stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL)
        return Path(out.decode().strip())
    except subprocess.CalledProcessError:
        print("Error: not inside a git repository", file=sys.stderr)
        sys.exit(1)

WORKSPACE = get_workspace()
AGENTS_DIR = WORKSPACE / "agents"
CONTEXT_FILES = ["AGENTS.md", "TOOLS.md", "USER.md", "MEMORY.md", "HEARTBEAT.md", "SOUL.md"]

# Load NVIDIA API key from main agent auth-profiles
def load_api_key() -> str:
    auth_path = Path("/root/.openclaw/agents/main/agent/auth-profiles.json")
    if not auth_path.exists():
        raise FileNotFoundError(f"Auth profiles not found at {auth_path}")
    with open(auth_path) as f:
        data = json.load(f)
    providers = data.get("profiles", {})
    for pid, p in providers.items():
        if "nvidia" in pid.lower():
            return p["key"]
    raise KeyError("NVIDIA provider not found in auth-profiles.json")

API_KEY = load_api_key()
OPENROUTER_BASE = "https://integrate.api.nvidia.com/v1"
MODEL = "moonshotai/kimi-k2.5"

def estimate_tokens(text: str) -> int:
    words = len(text.split())
    return max(1, int(words * 1.3))

def ask_ai(content: str, filename: str) -> dict:
    system_prompt = """You are a defragmentation assistant for AI agent context files.
Your job: analyze the provided file and suggest improvements to reduce token usage while preserving essential information.

Return ONLY a JSON object with these fields:
{
  "current_tokens": <int>,
  "projected_tokens": <int>,
  "cleaned_content": "<string>",
  "suggested_skills": [
    {
      "name": "snake_case_skill_name",
      "path": "skills/skills/<name>/SKILL.md",
      "content": "---\nname: ...\ndescription: ...\n---\n<markdown>"
    }
  ]
}

Guidelines:
- Remove placeholder lines: those that are blank or contain only words like "old", "deprecated", "TODO", "FIXME", "XXX", "HACK", or clearly gibberish (long unbroken strings >100 chars).
- Condense verbose sections: shorten explanations without losing meaning. Prefer concise bullet points over paragraphs.
- Extract any code snippets, API documentation, tool definitions, or reusable knowledge into separate skill files under `skills/skills/<name>/SKILL.md`.
- Keep the file's core identity (e.g., in SOUL.md keep personality; in USER.md keep user prefs).
- If no changes needed, set cleaned_content identical to input and suggested_skills empty.
"""

    user_prompt = f"File: {filename}\n\nContent:\n{content}"
    messages = [
        {"role": "system", "content": system_prompt},
        {"role": "user", "content": user_prompt}
    ]
    payload = {
        "model": MODEL,
        "messages": messages,
        "temperature": 0.2,
        "max_tokens": 4000,
        "stream": False
    }
    data = json.dumps(payload).encode("utf-8")
    req = Request(
        f"{OPENROUTER_BASE}/chat/completions",
        data=data,
        headers={
            "Authorization": f"Bearer {API_KEY}",
            "Content-Type": "application/json"
        },
        method="POST"
    )
    try:
        with urlopen(req, timeout=120) as resp:
            resp_bytes = resp.read()
            resp_json = json.loads(resp_bytes.decode("utf-8"))
            content_out = resp_json["choices"][0]["message"]["content"]
            m = re.search(r"```json\n(.*?)\n```", content_out, re.DOTALL)
            if m:
                json_str = m.group(1)
            else:
                json_str = content_out.strip()
            return json.loads(json_str)
    except HTTPError as e:
        err_body = e.read().decode("utf-8") if e.fp else ""
        raise RuntimeError(f"OpenRouter request failed: {e.code} {e.reason} - {err_body}") from e
    except URLError as e:
        raise RuntimeError(f"OpenRouter request failed: {e.reason}") from e
    except Exception as e:
        raise RuntimeError(f"OpenRouter request failed: {e}") from e

def apply_changes(agent_id: str, filename: str, ai_result: dict) -> Tuple[int, int, List[Path]]:
    base_path = WORKSPACE if agent_id == "main" else AGENTS_DIR / agent_id
    file_path = base_path / filename

    current_tokens = ai_result["current_tokens"]
    projected_tokens = ai_result["projected_tokens"]
    cleaned_content = ai_result["cleaned_content"]
    skills = ai_result.get("suggested_skills", [])

    created_skills = []

    original = file_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8") if file_path.exists() else ""
    if cleaned_content != original:
        file_path.write_text(cleaned_content, encoding="utf-8")

    for skill in skills:
        name = skill["name"]
        rel_path = Path(skill["path"])
        if rel_path.is_absolute():
            skill_path = rel_path
        else:
            skill_path = WORKSPACE / rel_path
        if not str(skill_path).startswith(str(WORKSPACE)):
            print(f"Warning: skill path {skill_path} outside workspace, skipping")
            continue
        skill_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        skill_path.write_text(skill["content"], encoding="utf-8")
        created_skills.append(skill_path)

    return current_tokens, projected_tokens, created_skills

def move_skills_to_agents():
    skills_dir = WORKSPACE / "skills" / "skills"
    if not skills_dir.exists():
        return []
    moved = []
    for d in skills_dir.iterdir():
        if not d.is_dir():
            continue
        skill_name = d.name
        agent_dir = AGENTS_DIR / skill_name
        if agent_dir.exists():
            target_dir = agent_dir / "skills" / skill_name
            target_dir.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            subprocess.run(["mv", str(d), str(target_dir)], check=True)
            moved.append((d, target_dir))
    return moved

def main(dry_run: bool = False):
    print(f"Workspace: {WORKSPACE}")
    print(f"Agents dir: {AGENTS_DIR}")
    print(f"Mode: {'DRY RUN' if dry_run else 'APPLY'}")

    agents = ["main"] + [d.name for d in AGENTS_DIR.iterdir() if d.is_dir() and not d.name.startswith('.')]
    print(f"Agents: {agents}")

    total_cur = 0
    total_proj = 0
    files_modified = 0
    agents_affected = 0

    for agent in agents:
        print(f"\n== Agent: {agent} =")
        base = WORKSPACE if agent == "main" else AGENTS_DIR / agent
        if not base.exists():
            print(f"  (missing, skipping)")
            continue
        agent_has_files = False
        for fname in CONTEXT_FILES:
            fpath = base / fname
            if not fpath.exists():
                continue
            agent_has_files = True
            content = fpath.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
            cur_tokens = estimate_tokens(content)
            print(f"  {fname}: {cur_tokens} tokens")
            try:
                result = ask_ai(content, fname)
                proj_tokens = result["projected_tokens"]
                saved = cur_tokens - proj_tokens
                print(f"    -> projected: {proj_tokens} tokens (saved {saved})")
                if not dry_run:
                    applied_cur, applied_proj, created = apply_changes(agent, fname, result)
                    files_modified += 1
                else:
                    total_cur += cur_tokens
                    total_proj += proj_tokens
            except Exception as e:
                print(f"    [ERROR] AI analysis failed: {e}")
                total_cur += cur_tokens
                total_proj += cur_tokens
                continue
        if agent_has_files:
            agents_affected += 1

    if not dry_run:
        moved = move_skills_to_agents()
        for src, dst in moved:
            print(f"  Moved skill {src.name} -> {dst}")

        if files_modified > 0 or moved:
            print("\nCommitting changes...")
            try:
                subprocess.run(["git", "add", "-A"], cwd=WORKSPACE, check=True)
                subprocess.run(["git", "commit", "-m", f"defrag: optimize contexts"], cwd=WORKSPACE, check=False)
                print("Committed.")
            except subprocess.CalledProcessError as e:
                print(f"Git commit failed: {e}")
        else:
            print("\nNo changes to commit.")
    else:
        print("\nNo changes to commit (dry run).")

    print("\n== Summary ==")
    print(f"Agents affected: {agents_affected}")
    print(f"Files modified: {files_modified}")
    print(f"Total tokens: {total_cur} -> {total_proj} (saved {total_cur - total_proj})")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--dry-run", action="store_true", help="Do not write changes")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    main(dry_run=args.dry_run)

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
Defrag skill: Multi-agent context optimization using AI (same model as main agent).
"""

import os
import sys
import json
import re
import subprocess
import argparse
from pathlib import Path
from urllib.request import Request, urlopen
from urllib.error import URLError, HTTPError
from typing import Dict, List, Tuple

# Determine workspace root
def get_workspace() -> Path:
    try:
        out = subprocess.check_output(["git", "rev-parse", "--show-toplevel"], stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL)
        return Path(out.decode().strip())
    except subprocess.CalledProcessError:
        print("Error: not inside a git repository", file=sys.stderr)
        sys.exit(1)

WORKSPACE = get_workspace()
AGENTS_DIR = WORKSPACE / "agents"
CONTEXT_FILES = ["AGENTS.md", "TOOLS.md", "USER.md", "MEMORY.md", "HEARTBEAT.md", "SOUL.md"]

# Load main agent's default model and corresponding API credentials
def get_main_agent_config() -> (str, str, str):
    """
    Returns (base_url, api_key, model_id)
    by reading openclaw.json and the main agent's auth-profiles.json.
    """
    # Read gateway config to find main agent's default model
    config_path = Path("/root/.openclaw/openclaw.json")
    if not config_path.exists():
        raise FileNotFoundError(f"Gateway config not found at {config_path}")
    with open(config_path) as f:
        config = json.load(f)
    # Find the model ID for main agent (use defaults if not overridden)
    agents_list = config.get("agents", {}).get("list", [])
    main_agent_cfg = next((a for a in agents_list if a.get("id") == "main"), {})
    model_id = main_agent_cfg.get("model") or config.get("agents", {}).get("defaults", {}).get("model", {}).get("primary")
    if not model_id:
        raise KeyError("Could not determine main agent's model from openclaw.json")
    # Determine provider from model ID prefix (e.g., "openrouter/..." -> openrouter)
    provider_key = model_id.split("/")[0].lower()
    # Load main agent's auth profiles to get provider credentials
    auth_path = Path("/root/.openclaw/agents/main/agent/auth-profiles.json")
    if not auth_path.exists():
        raise FileNotFoundError(f"Auth profiles not found at {auth_path}")
    with open(auth_path) as f:
        auth_data = json.load(f)
    providers = auth_data.get("profiles", {})
    # Find matching provider
    provider_cfg = None
    for pid, p in providers.items():
        if provider_key in pid.lower():
            provider_cfg = p
            break
    if not provider_cfg:
        raise KeyError(f"Provider '{provider_key}' not found in main agent auth-profiles")
    api_key = provider_cfg.get("apiKey") or provider_cfg.get("key")
    if not api_key:
        raise KeyError(f"API key missing in provider config {pid}")
    # Determine base URL from provider config or from known mapping
    base_url = provider_cfg.get("baseUrl")
    if not base_url:
        # Map provider to default base URLs
        if provider_key == "openrouter":
            base_url = "https://openrouter.ai/api/v1"
        elif provider_key == "nvidia":
            base_url = "https://integrate.api.nvidia.com/v1"
        elif provider_key == "opencode":
            base_url = "https://opencode.ai/zen/v1"
        else:
            raise ValueError(f"Unknown provider '{provider_key}' and no baseUrl in config")
    return base_url, api_key, model_id

BASE_URL, API_KEY, MODEL = get_main_agent_config()

def estimate_tokens(text: str) -> int:
    words = len(text.split())
    return max(1, int(words * 1.3))

def ask_ai(content: str, filename: str) -> dict:
    system_prompt = """You are a defragmentation assistant for AI agent context files.
Your job: analyze the provided file and suggest improvements to reduce token usage while preserving essential information.

Return ONLY a JSON object with these fields:
{
  "current_tokens": <int>,
  "projected_tokens": <int>,
  "cleaned_content": "<string>",
  "suggested_skills": [
    {
      "name": "snake_case_skill_name",
      "path": "skills/skills/<name>/SKILL.md",
      "content": "---\nname: ...\ndescription: ...\n---\n<markdown>"
    }
  ]
}

Guidelines:
- Remove placeholder lines: those that are blank or contain only words like "old", "deprecated", "TODO", "FIXME", "XXX", "HACK", or clearly gibberish (long unbroken strings >100 chars).
- Condense verbose sections: shorten explanations without losing meaning. Prefer concise bullet points over paragraphs.
- Extract any code snippets, API documentation, tool definitions, or reusable knowledge into separate skill files under `skills/skills/<name>/SKILL.md`.
- Keep the file's core identity (e.g., in SOUL.md keep personality; in USER.md keep user prefs).
- If no changes needed, set cleaned_content identical to input and suggested_skills empty.
"""

    user_prompt = f"File: {filename}\n\nContent:\n{content}"
    messages = [
        {"role": "system", "content": system_prompt},
        {"role": "user", "content": user_prompt}
    ]
    payload = {
        "model": MODEL,
        "messages": messages,
        "temperature": 0.2,
        "max_tokens": 4000,
        "stream": False
    }
    data = json.dumps(payload).encode("utf-8")
    req = Request(
        f"{BASE_URL}/chat/completions",
        data=data,
        headers={
            "Authorization": f"Bearer {API_KEY}",
            "Content-Type": "application/json"
        },
        method="POST"
    )
    try:
        with urlopen(req, timeout=120) as resp:
            resp_bytes = resp.read()
            resp_json = json.loads(resp_bytes.decode("utf-8"))
            content_out = resp_json["choices"][0]["message"]["content"]
            m = re.search(r"```json\n(.*?)\n```", content_out, re.DOTALL)
            if m:
                json_str = m.group(1)
            else:
                json_str = content_out.strip()
            return json.loads(json_str)
    except HTTPError as e:
        err_body = e.read().decode("utf-8") if e.fp else ""
        raise RuntimeError(f"API request failed: {e.code} {e.reason} - {err_body}") from e
    except URLError as e:
        raise RuntimeError(f"API request failed: {e.reason}") from e
    except Exception as e:
        raise RuntimeError(f"API request failed: {e}") from e

def apply_changes(agent_id: str, filename: str, ai_result: dict) -> Tuple[int, int, List[Path]]:
    base_path = WORKSPACE if agent_id == "main" else AGENTS_DIR / agent_id
    file_path = base_path / filename

    current_tokens = ai_result["current_tokens"]
    projected_tokens = ai_result["projected_tokens"]
    cleaned_content = ai_result["cleaned_content"]
    skills = ai_result.get("suggested_skills", [])

    created_skills = []

    original = file_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8") if file_path.exists() else ""
    if cleaned_content != original:
        file_path.write_text(cleaned_content, encoding="utf-8")

    for skill in skills:
        name = skill["name"]
        rel_path = Path(skill["path"])
        if rel_path.is_absolute():
            skill_path = rel_path
        else:
            skill_path = WORKSPACE / rel_path
        if not str(skill_path).startswith(str(WORKSPACE)):
            print(f"Warning: skill path {skill_path} outside workspace, skipping")
            continue
        skill_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        skill_path.write_text(skill["content"], encoding="utf-8")
        created_skills.append(skill_path)

    return current_tokens, projected_tokens, created_skills

def move_skills_to_agents():
    skills_dir = WORKSPACE / "skills" / "skills"
    if not skills_dir.exists():
        return []
    moved = []
    for d in skills_dir.iterdir():
        if not d.is_dir():
            continue
        skill_name = d.name
        agent_dir = AGENTS_DIR / skill_name
        if agent_dir.exists():
            target_dir = agent_dir / "skills" / skill_name
            target_dir.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            subprocess.run(["mv", str(d), str(target_dir)], check=True)
            moved.append((d, target_dir))
    return moved

def main(dry_run: bool = False):
    print(f"Workspace: {WORKSPACE}")
    print(f"Agents dir: {AGENTS_DIR}")
    print(f"Using model: {MODEL} ({BASE_URL})")
    print(f"Mode: {'DRY RUN' if dry_run else 'APPLY'}")

    agents = ["main"] + [d.name for d in AGENTS_DIR.iterdir() if d.is_dir() and not d.name.startswith('.')]
    print(f"Agents: {agents}")

    total_cur = 0
    total_proj = 0
    files_modified = 0
    agents_affected = 0

    for agent in agents:
        print(f"\n== Agent: {agent} =")
        base = WORKSPACE if agent == "main" else AGENTS_DIR / agent
        if not base.exists():
            print(f"  (missing, skipping)")
            continue
        agent_has_files = False
        for fname in CONTEXT_FILES:
            fpath = base / fname
            if not fpath.exists():
                continue
            agent_has_files = True
            content = fpath.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
            cur_tokens = estimate_tokens(content)
            print(f"  {fname}: {cur_tokens} tokens")
            try:
                result = ask_ai(content, fname)
                proj_tokens = result["projected_tokens"]
                saved = cur_tokens - proj_tokens
                print(f"    -> projected: {proj_tokens} tokens (saved {saved})")
                if not dry_run:
                    applied_cur, applied_proj, created = apply_changes(agent, fname, result)
                    files_modified += 1
                else:
                    total_cur += cur_tokens
                    total_proj += proj_tokens
            except Exception as e:
                print(f"    [ERROR] AI analysis failed: {e}")
                total_cur += cur_tokens
                total_proj += cur_tokens
                continue
        if agent_has_files:
            agents_affected += 1

    if not dry_run:
        moved = move_skills_to_agents()
        for src, dst in moved:
            print(f"  Moved skill {src.name} -> {dst}")

        if files_modified > 0 or moved:
            print("\nCommitting changes...")
            try:
                subprocess.run(["git", "add", "-A"], cwd=WORKSPACE, check=True)
                subprocess.run(["git", "commit", "-m", f"defrag: optimize contexts"], cwd=WORKSPACE, check=False)
                print("Committed.")
            except subprocess.CalledProcessError as e:
                print(f"Git commit failed: {e}")
        else:
            print("\nNo changes to commit.")
    else:
        print("\nNo changes to commit (dry run).")

    print("\n== Summary ==")
    print(f"Agents affected: {agents_affected}")
    print(f"Files modified: {files_modified}")
    print(f"Total tokens: {total_cur} -> {total_proj} (saved {total_cur - total_proj})")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--dry-run", action="store_true", help="Do not write changes")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    main(dry_run=args.dry_run)

# Load main agent's default model and corresponding API credentials
def get_main_agent_config() -> (str, str, str):
    """
    Returns (base_url, api_key, model_id)
    by reading openclaw.json and the main agent's auth-profiles.json.
    """
    # Read gateway config to find main agent's default model
    config_path = Path("/root/.openclaw/openclaw.json")
    if not config_path.exists():
        raise FileNotFoundError(f"Gateway config not found at {config_path}")
    with open(config_path) as f:
        config = json.load(f)
    # Find the model ID for main agent (use defaults if not overridden)
    agents_list = config.get("agents", {}).get("list", [])
    main_agent_cfg = next((a for a in agents_list if a.get("id") == "main"), {})
    model_id = main_agent_cfg.get("model") or config.get("agents", {}).get("defaults", {}).get("model", {}).get("primary")
    if not model_id:
        raise KeyError("Could not determine main agent's model from openclaw.json")
    # Determine provider from model ID prefix (e.g., "openrouter/..." -> openrouter)
    # The stored model ID may include provider prefix (like "openrouter/stepfun/step-3.5-flash:free").
    # We need to separate them: provider = prefix before first '/', actual_model = rest.
    if "/" in model_id:
        provider_key, actual_model = model_id.split("/", 1)
    else:
        provider_key = model_id
        actual_model = model_id
    # Load main agent's auth profiles to get provider credentials
    auth_path = Path("/root/.openclaw/agents/main/agent/auth-profiles.json")
    if not auth_path.exists():
        raise FileNotFoundError(f"Auth profiles not found at {auth_path}")
    with open(auth_path) as f:
        auth_data = json.load(f)
    providers = auth_data.get("profiles", {})
    # Find matching provider profile by key (case-insensitive)
    provider_cfg = None
    for pid, p in providers.items():
        if provider_key.lower() in pid.lower():
            provider_cfg = p
            break
    if not provider_cfg:
        raise KeyError(f"Provider '{provider_key}' not found in main agent auth-profiles")
    api_key = provider_cfg.get("apiKey") or provider_cfg.get("key")
    if not api_key:
        raise KeyError(f"API key missing in provider config {pid}")
    # Determine base URL from provider config or from known mapping
    base_url = provider_cfg.get("baseUrl")
    if not base_url:
        # Map provider to default base URLs
        if provider_key == "openrouter":
            base_url = "https://openrouter.ai/api/v1"
        elif provider_key == "nvidia":
            base_url = "https://integrate.api.nvidia.com/v1"
        elif provider_key == "opencode":
            base_url = "https://opencode.ai/zen/v1"
        else:
            raise ValueError(f"Unknown provider '{provider_key}' and no baseUrl in config")
    return base_url, api_key, actual_model

BASE_URL, API_KEY, MODEL = get_main_agent_config()
